decoder.name: M4-12 causal T15 GRU-CTC + phoneme-to-word decoder (ours)
training_data: B2T '25 HDF5 train partition (CC0); it holds about 368 of the 816 b2t25-t15 test trials, so only the val_eval trials are scored
decoder.training_regime: one participant; held-out trials of training sessions

policy.name: drop-in guard (P14-03 recipe)
policy.description: fidetype.trust.calibrate, alpha 0.05, delta 0.1, decode_fn = the T15 phoneme-to-word decoder

basis.shuffled: decoder output level: the frames of each val_eval log-prob matrix permuted in time (seeded by the unit hash); the network was not rerun
basis.zeros: decoder output level: uniform log-probs of the same length; the network was not run on zero input

guarantee.scope: marginal over the scored val_eval trials; exchangeable val_select / val_eval; the bound covers the pool (all days of one participant together), not each day: one day can be worse (trust guarantee section 4: https://github.com/zhangzibo/fidetype/blob/main/docs/trust-guarantee.md#4-what-is-not-guaranteed)
guarantee.calibration_split: decoder val_select partition minus every b2t25-t15 test trial

safe_wpm.calibration: decoder val_select partition minus every b2t25-t15 test trial

correction_rule.name: rewrite
correction_rule.formula: 2 s + 0.7895 s/char * len(truth) per wrong commit

safe_wpm.no_bci_note: gaze typing of every sentence at 20 chars/min (the eWPM reference)

safe_wpm_v02.definition_status: adopted 2026-11-22: the headline metric (prefix credit + the aac-gaze-v1 reading cost); safe-wpm/0.1 stays selectable with metric_version='0.1' for old numbers
safe_wpm_v02.calibration: decoder val_select partition minus every b2t25-t15 test trial

correction_rule.name: rewrite
correction_rule.formula: 2 s + 0.7895 s/char * len(truth) per wrong commit
correction_rule.prefix: a wrong prefix of k words costs the penalty of the first k words of the truth

reading_cost.formula: 0.5 s + 0.3 s/word * k per commit (right or wrong); prefix commits with fewer than 1 word(s) count as no commit
reading_cost.note: the adopted safe-wpm/0.2 reading cost (2026-11-22) is 0.5 s + 0.3 s/word per commit, minimum prefix 1 word; other values give a sensitivity variant

safe_wpm_v02.no_bci_note: gaze typing of every sentence at 20 chars/min (the eWPM reference)

notes: Drop-in guard (P14-03 recipe, as P14-05) calibrated on 616 val_select trials (the 106 val_select trials that are track test units are removed). Checkpoint chosen on val_select PER. Not comparable with full-coverage entries.

2026-11-25: the scope line now says that the bound covers the pool of all days of one participant, not each day (trust guarantee section 4). Basis: the pooled-guard check (commit 74a21f8; https://github.com/zhangzibo/fidetype/blob/main/experiments/2026-11-25-pooled-guard-check/results.md). No number changed.

track_info.title: Intracortical attempted speech, T15 copy task (Brain-to-Text '25)
track_info.rate_source: measured T15 speech rate, 125k trials (v0.1 track)

coverage.subset: 103 of 816 test trials: only trials in the decoder's held-out val_eval partition (matched by day and sentence, one-to-one) are scored. The other test trials are in the decoder's train (about 368) or val_select (about 106) partitions, or have no match.
